name: interview-studio

scripts.typecheck: cd apps/backend && npx --no-install tsc --noEmit && cd ../frontend && npx --no-install tsc --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.build: npm --prefix apps/backend run build && npm --prefix apps/frontend run build
scripts.audit: npm --prefix apps/backend audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high && npm --prefix apps/frontend audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high

description: Guided conversations with AI interviewers to help you find your voice and get helpful feedback
